theorems.statement: ∀ (n N p : ℕ) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (f : Rn N → Rn p) (D : Set (Rn n)) (K C : ℝ≥0) (J : Rn N → ℝ) (S : Set (Rn N)) (h : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞), IsCompact D → (∀ u ∈ D, DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ u) → (∀ u ∈ D, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ u)) → LipschitzOnWith K ψ D → (∀ u ∈ D, ∀ v ∈ D, dist u v ≤ (C : ℝ) * dist (ψ u) (ψ v)) → LipschitzOnWith K (f ∘ ψ) D → S ⊆ ψ '' D → NullMeasurableSet S μHE[n] → (∀ᵐ u ∂(volume : Measure (Rn n)), u ∈ D → ψ u ∈ S → DifferentiableAt ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u ∧ J (ψ u) * (fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap.normDet = (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u).toLinearMap.normDet) → AEMeasurable h ((μHE[n] : Measure (Rn N)).restrict S) → (∫⁻ x in S, h x * ENNReal.ofReal (J x) ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ y, ∑' x : ↥(S ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}), h x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ AEMeasurable (fun y ↦ ∑' x : ↥(S ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}), h x) (μHE[n] : Measure (Rn p))
